name: Article 1, § 1 – 2
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council on the adoption by the Union of the Agreement on the interpretation and application of the Energy Charter Treaty between the European Union, the European Atomic Energy Community and their Member States
part_text: The Agreement in the Annex is hereby adopted, subject to the signing, on behalf of the Union, of the said Agreement.The adoption of the Agreement by the Union and its Member States shall be without prejudice to the national competences in the field of energy supply and investment protection. Member States shall retain the right to enact their own provisions in accordance with their respective constitutional requirements.
